how.title: How It Works
how.subtitle: Build and publish your website in 3 simple steps without coding or installations.
how.step1.title: 1. Fill In Your Details and Styles
how.step1.desc: Enter your company name, sector, and contact points. Pick your preferred palette and layout style.
how.step2.title: 2. Live Preview and Customize
how.step2.desc: Your site takes form immediately in your browser. Toggle sections on or off and test across screen sizes.
how.step3.title: 3. One-Click Download and Host
how.step3.desc: Download your ready-to-use site as a clean .ZIP containing valid HTML, modern CSS, and a guide. Host on GitHub Pages, Netlify, or anywhere for free.
how.features.title: Why Site Workshop?
how.features.f1: Completely Free & Open: No server fees, API costs, or hidden recurring charges.
how.features.f2: Zero Dependencies: Produced websites rely purely on semantic HTML5 and clean CSS.
how.features.f3: Absolute Privacy: No data leaves your machine; everything executes locally in your browser.
privacy.title: Privacy & Security
privacy.subtitle: Your data stays entirely in your hands.
privacy.card1.title: No Server & No Database
privacy.card1.desc: Site Workshop is a strictly static client-side application. The business names, emails, and numbers you provide are never stored on any remote server.
privacy.card2.title: No Cookies & No Analytics
privacy.card2.desc: There are no trackers, third-party advertising cookies, or telemetry scripts. Only your chosen language preference is saved in your browser's localStorage.
privacy.card3.title: External Requests
privacy.card3.desc: No paid APIs are called. The only optional outbound network request is fetching open-source web fonts directly from Google Fonts.
privacy.card4.title: Clean Code & XSS Protection
privacy.card4.desc: All user-provided values in the generated website are securely escaped to guard against script injection and adhere to standard web standards.
